title: Tata Sons shake-up could hit Tata Group credit ratings, S&P warns
excerpt: S&P Global Ratings has indicated that upcoming changes within the Tata Group may affect credit quality. The agency pointed out that leadership transitions could challenge the continuity of the group's strategies and financial policies. Significant growth plans exist for various Tata companies, emphasizing their importance to Tata Sons. A potential public listing of Tata Sons might introduce public shareholder scrutiny and impact group support assessments.
